meta.description: Check progress for a detached KERMT run (pretrain, finetune, or any kermt_run_detached invocation). Reads run.json, queries docker for container state, tails the pretrain/finetune log, and parses progress lines (epoch, step, val loss).

functional_suitability.note: Complete monitoring workflow covering container state, log tailing, progress parsing, and test metrics; works across all KERMT training workflows with graceful degradation for unknown workflows

reliability.note: Handles container absence gracefully with inspect fallback; works in degraded mode without run.json; minor: no guidance on handling corrupted log files or unparseable progress lines

performance_context.note: Excellent efficiency: 176 lines well within target; explicit line/token budget comment shows awareness; clean single-file structure

agent_usability.note: Clear 8-step workflow; both one-shot and streaming modes; JSON output for programmatic use; minor: container_name plumbing issue acknowledged but workaround not fully specified

human_usability.note: Excellent composability with detached KERMT workflows; clear input options (run-dir or --container); stop/cleanup hints provided; no GPU requirements

security.note: Explicit read-only constraint on user data and run.json; never kills container without user instruction; no image modification; proper separation of monitoring from execution

maintainability.note: Clean single-file structure; workflow dispatch pattern extensible; minor: log file naming convention hardcoded in case statement could be externalized

agent_specific.note: Excellent composability as companion skill for all detached KERMT workflows; clear scope (monitoring only); hard rules prevent dangerous operations; lacks explicit idempotency statement; container_name plumbing gap acknowledged

key_strengths: Exceptional composability: designed as companion skill for all detached KERMT workflows with unified monitoring interface
Graceful degradation: works without run.json via --container flag, handles missing logs with most-recent fallback

recommendations.title: Add guidance for corrupted or unparseable log files
recommendations.problem: No handling documented for scenarios where log file exists but contains unparseable content or is corrupted
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes log files are well-formed; parsing failures not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to workflow after step 5: 'If progress parsing fails (malformed lines, unexpected format), show raw tail output with warning: Progress parsing failed, showing raw log. Container may have crashed or log format changed.'

recommendations.title: Specify container_name fallback workaround
recommendations.problem: Note on container_name plumbing acknowledges run.json doesn't include container name but filesystem-based fallback not fully specified
recommendations.root_cause: Known limitation documented but workaround implementation left vague
recommendations.fix: Expand container_name plumbing note: 'Fallback: list docker ps -a --filter label=kermt.run_dir=<run_dir> if label present, or match container name pattern kermt-<workflow>-* with creation time near run.json started_at timestamp. If multiple matches, prefer most recent.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for repeated monitoring
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running monitor multiple times has side effects or affects running container
recommendations.root_cause: Read-only nature implied by hard rules but not explicitly stated as idempotent
recommendations.fix: Add to Hard rules: 'Idempotency: monitoring is fully read-only and idempotent — running kermt-monitor multiple times has no effect on the running container or training state. Safe to invoke repeatedly or in parallel.'
